hypothesis: Raise the existing value session threshold from 9 MiB to 36 MiB to reduce budget-driven resets while retaining every declaration-order, failure and typing-context boundary. No other optimization is combined.
configuration: One prespecified threshold (36 MiB); ARENA_KEEP remains four times the threshold. No parameter sweep.
motivation: Full native census emitted 14418 session records over Mathlib. Leaders reuse forward sessions with distinct memory limits; their limits count different objects, so this Flash threshold must be tested independently.
cost_gate: Two alternating exact 25131-declaration prefix pairs, two workers, complete ACCEPTs, three exact loop controls; each pair and aggregate must save at least 1% software instructions.
correctness_gate: Existing library and retained-source tests plus 16 source controls before cost comparison. Full portable corpus and full original Mathlib acceptance, instruction cost and peak memory required before promotion.
boundary: Larger caches can cost more memory or expose latent invalid reuse; no Arena speed is inferred from a prefix. Unchanged semantics is a hypothesis until qualification.
